{{Quote|Bringing him to justice will be a major blow to Black Sun. He knows where a lot of bodies are buried.|Corran Horn to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Voydd Blancken''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate's presence on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] had Blancken arrested based on evidence procured from [[Obrio Caldori]], a lower-ranking Black Sun manager.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempCommonerRodianMale.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Voydd Blancken]]
Voydd Blancken was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
